THE VENTRICULAR ASSIST SYSTEM IS INDICATED FOR USE AS A BRIDGE TO CARDIAC TRANSPLANTATION IN PATIENTS WHO ARE AT RISK OF DEATH FROM REFRACTORY END-STAGE LEFT VENTRICULAR HEART FAILURE. THE SYSTEM IS DESIGNED FOR IN-HOSPITAL AND OUT-OF-HOSPITAL SETTINGS, INCLUDING TRANSPORTATION. THIS EVENT IS A KNOWN MALFUNCTION WHICH IS CURRENTLY UNDER INVESTIGATION BY THE MANUFAC
